title: HTTP Server Banner Detection
description: The HTTP response disclosed the web server product name.
evidence: The Server response header identified the web server software.
remediation: Consider minimizing unnecessary server banner disclosure.
risk_reason: 仅检测到服务器产品信息，没有直接漏洞证据

title: Missing Content Security Policy Header
description: The application response does not contain a Content-Security-Policy header.
evidence: The inspected HTTP response headers confirmed that Content-Security-Policy was absent.
remediation: Review whether an appropriate Content Security Policy should be configured.
risk_reason: 响应头已确认缺少安全策略头

title: Possible SQL Injection Behavior
description: The scanner observed a different application response after supplying unusual input.
evidence: One modified request caused HTTP 500, but no database error message or additional confirmation was observed.
remediation: Perform authorized manual verification and review server-side query handling.
risk_reason: 存在异常响应，但目前不足以确认 SQL 注入

title: Possible Git Repository Exposure
description: The scanner reported that a Git repository metadata path may be publicly accessible.
evidence: The requested Git metadata path returned HTTP 200, but the response body was the application's generic fallback page and contained no Git metadata.
remediation: Confirm routing behavior and ensure repository metadata is not publicly served.
risk_reason: HTTP 状态码命中，但响应内容与 Git 元数据不匹配

title: TLS Certificate Information
description: The scanner collected the subject, issuer and validity information of the TLS certificate.
evidence: Certificate metadata was successfully retrieved from the HTTPS service.
risk_reason: 属于证书信息收集结果，本身未表明存在安全问题

title: Default Credential Authentication Confirmed
description: The scanner reported that the administrative interface accepted a known default credential combination.
evidence: Authentication succeeded and the authenticated administration page was returned.
remediation: Replace default credentials immediately and review administrative access controls.
risk_reason: 认证成功已经直接支持默认凭证仍可使用的发现

title: Possible Directory Listing
description: The scanner observed a response that may indicate directory listing is enabled.
evidence: The page title contained 'Index of', but the captured response did not include file or directory entries.
remediation: Verify the directory manually and disable directory listing if it is enabled.
risk_reason: 存在目录索引迹象，但缺少实际文件列表作为确认依据

title: Possible Secret Exposure
description: The scanner detected a password-related keyword in a publicly accessible page.
evidence: The matched text was an example sentence in public documentation explaining how users can change a password. No credential value or secret was present.
remediation: No immediate remediation is required unless additional sensitive data is discovered.
risk_reason: 关键词虽然命中，但上下文属于普通文档说明，并未发现真实凭据
